objective: P8 cannot be completed before P7 establishes an approved product requirements baseline.
scenario: The project state marks P8 complete and the technical design artifact is approved, but P7 is not present in completed_stages.
expected_behaviors: Block P8 completion until P7 is complete.
Require the PRD approval gate to be satisfied before accepting technical-design completion.
prohibited_behaviors: Treat an approved technical design as sufficient to bypass the P7 product-definition gate.
